name: XCC_STREAM_DATA_SETS_GT
description: This temporary table contains identifiers of budget import runs and budgetary control validation requests that have not yet been updated to the budgetary control balances cubes. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies the budget import runs or budgetary control validation requests with pending updates.

columns.name: CUBE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the budgetary control balances cube with pending updates.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the type of transaction with pending updates.

columns.name: DATA_SET_TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the update status of the balances to the budgetary control balances cube by data set. Valid values are PENDING, SUCCESS, MIXED, FAILED, and NO_CUBES.
